limitations: All grades are provisional browser assessments using the supplied screenshots and runtime summary; no independent browser drive or raw evidence-file inspection was performed.
Normal, enlarged and transition variants are grouped with their corresponding task states; different scroll positions are not treated as proof of unreachable controls.
Supplied runtime results support interaction scores, but still images do not independently establish motion quality, focus order, hit areas or persistence.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, native performance and actual OS purchase/share-sheet behavior remain deferred without deductions solely for that boundary.
Connected social behavior, successful native voice capture and real billing are not established by the supplied states.
Synthetic forecast, explanation and performance fixtures establish layout coverage only, not predictive quality or production wording defects.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied evidence; cropped scrolled content warrants visual improvements but does not alone prove inaccessible actions.

The authorized threshold is not met: numerous screens and components have aesthetic or functional means below 9, especially surface integration, long centered content and constrained enlarged editors.
topFixes: Give constrained 200% editors more writing height and unmistakable internal scroll cues.
Shorten centered introductions and group long explanations so fields, choices and primary actions remain easier to connect.
Strengthen contact shadows, material edges and shared lighting for the orb, wooden actions, destination mounting and floating bottles.
Improve comparison layouts for city results, plan options and history metadata using short centered groups.
Simplify action stacks and repeated disclosure content, especially forecast, sharing and check-in screens.
Make clipboard-fallback URLs easier to select within a bounded field and keep enlarged content visibly separated from persistent controls.
